body_markdown:
The following fixes and features are available on the[stable](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/version-management#production-environment) channel:


### Features & Improvements


-


Added[custom theme](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/image-editor/configuration#theme) support to the[Image Editor](https://docs.unlayer.com/builder/latest/image-editor/quickstart) .


-


Retired legacy AI tools and moved AI access to per-subscription extensions.


-


Added shared rate limiting across Unlayer services, with consistent` 429` responses and guidance on when to retry.


-


Replaced the retired Gemini models used by Magic Image and the Image Editor for AI image generation and editing.


-


Added a one-time $10 Inbox Previews trial for Scale, Optimize, and Enterprise plans.


-


Added image generation and AI image editing to the AI Assistant and the public Images API.


-


Added WebMCP tools and the` unlayer.agent` API so agents can read, modify, validate, preview, and export designs while preserving undo support and protected content.


-


Added` Cmd+K` and` Ctrl+K` shortcuts for inserting links in the Paragraph and Heading tools.


-


Applied Document Builder page margins consistently in the editor and in PDF and HTML exports.


-


Updated the Paragraph tool to preserve links pasted from Google Docs and automatically turn URLs into links.


### Bug Fixes


-


Fixed Page Anchors failing to scroll to their targets in the editor preview.


-


Fixed exports omitting image width CSS unless the width slider had been adjusted.


-


Fixed URL encoding for apostrophes in image filenames.


-


Fixed an issue where using the AI Assistant in edit mode cancelled generation of the entire design.


-


Fixed missing AI-generated image alt text, incorrect success messages, and overlapping merge tag menus.


-


Fixed synced blocks shifting down one row after each refresh.


-


Fixed typing and text selection around smart merge tags in the Paragraph and Heading tools.


-


Fixed Countdown Timers disappearing when Outlook blocks images. The timer now displays its end date as alternate text.


-


Fixed the Save Block dialog hanging. Failed saves now explain the problem and preserve your entries. The dialog closes after a successful update to a saved block.


-


Fixed extra blank pages in Document Builder PDF exports so the exported pages match the canvas.
